# 13 – Pitfalls & Special Cases (cross-cutting)

This is an **index** of the gotchas found while writing chapters 00–12,
grouped by theme rather than by subsystem. Each entry names the pitfall in one
line. The explanation and code references live in the linked sections: the
first link goes to the section that explains the mechanism, the second to that
chapter's own "Pitfalls & special cases" list. Keep it at hand when you review
PRs or triage bugs, and **read section 1 before every review**.

## 1. Compatibility & ABI (read before every review)

* **Every master release must stay ABI-safe for SLE 15 (all codestreams build from `master`)** — [12 §9](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#9-branches-tags-and-codestreams) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Exporting needs `ZYPP_API` **and** a `zypp::*` match in `libzypp.map`; nothing outside `namespace zypp` is exported** — [12 §5](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#5-symbol-visibility-and-export-control) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Green tests prove nothing about exports (`zypp-allsym`); check `nm -DC`; tools must link `libzypp.so` (bsc#1228787)** — [12 §5](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#5-symbol-visibility-and-export-control) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Hidden visibility (17.33.0) needed re-exports for PackageKit/libyui/YaST (bsc#1228138, bsc#1228420)** — [12 §5](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#5-symbol-visibility-and-export-control) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Never add a virtual method to a report/callback class; use `UserData`/generic reports** — [02 §11](02-core-infrastructure.md#11-callback--report-system-zyppzyppcallbackh) · [pitfalls](02-core-infrastructure.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`zypp::shared_ptr` is `boost::shared_ptr` and is part of the ABI** — [02 §5](02-core-infrastructure.md#5-smart-pointers-reference-counting-pimpl) · [pitfalls](02-core-infrastructure.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`solver/detail` headers are exported for the testcase runner** — [04 §1](04-solver.md#1-file-map) · [pitfalls](04-solver.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **libsolv types in public headers: a libsolv ABI change can force a soname bump (bsc#1115341)** — [12 §2.3](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#23-history-of-soname-changes-from-libzyppchanges) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`LEGACY(1735)` changes class layout, `LEGACY(17)` guards `ConvertDBReport`; macro lacks outer parentheses** — [12 §6](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#6-legacy-guards) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Never delete files in `zypp/zypp-compat/` (17.35.0, #557)** — [12 §7.2](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#72-zyppzypp-compat) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`ZYPP_DEPRECATED` is empty in release builds** — [12 §7.1](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#71-zypp_deprecated) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`-D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64` in pkg-config flags affects the ABI** — [12 §4.6](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#46-rpmlint-and-pkg-config) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`zypp-rpm` and libzypp share headers; always ship them together** — [08 §6](08-target-commit-and-rpm.md#single-transaction-backend-commitinsingletransaction--zypp-rpm) · [pitfalls](08-target-commit-and-rpm.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Public headers are C++11; newer library features only through polyfills (`Exception.h`'s `if constexpr` is the one known exception)** — [02 §2](02-core-infrastructure.md#2-coding-conventions) · [pitfalls](02-core-infrastructure.md#pitfalls--special-cases)

## 2. Versioning & releasing

* **SONAME = `MAJOR*100 + COMPATMINOR`; COMPATMINOR must never exceed MINOR (17.33.4)** — [12 §2.2](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#22-soname-math-zyppcmakeliststxt) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`VERSION.cmake` comment is stale; real soname math is in `zypp/CMakeLists.txt`** — [12 §2.1](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#21-the-file-verbatim-comments-explained) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`mkChangelog` quirks (run from `zypp/`, needs previous tag, dry run if staged files, `# LAST RELEASED:` format)** — [12 §3.2](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#32-zyppmkchangelog) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Changelog comes from commit messages; SLE fixes need `(bsc#…)`/`(CVE-…)`** — [12 §3.1](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#31-changes-file-format-zypppackagelibzyppchanges) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`Provides: libzypp(...)` tags must match `FeatureTest.doc`** — [12 §4.4](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#44-dependencies--feature-provides) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **SLE 12 CVE fixes go to `SuSE-SLE-12-SP2-Branch` (different layout)** — [12 §18](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#18-maintenance-branches-verified-ref-listing) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **CI is `.obs/workflows.yml` + GitHub Pages; `.travis.yml` is dead** — [12 §13.3](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#133-pr-ci-via-obs-scmci-obsworkflowsyml) · [pitfalls](12-release-packaging-and-compat.md#pitfalls--special-cases)

## 3. Build system

* **Shared `zypp-logic` sources compile twice (C++17 legacy, C++20 NG); code must build both ways** — [01 §4](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#4-how-zypp-logiccmake-turns-shared-sources-into-per-generation-targets) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Same `ng/async` include resolves to different headers per build (`T` vs `Task<T>`)** — [10 §4.1](10-zyppng-next-generation.md#41-current-mechanism-maybeawaitable--overlay-headers) · [pitfalls](10-zyppng-next-generation.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`#ifdef ZYPP_ENABLE_ASYNC` in `zypp/zypp/ng/**` is dead code** — [10 §6](10-zyppng-next-generation.md#6-how-legacy-libzypp-uses-ng-code-today-production-paths) · [pitfalls](10-zyppng-next-generation.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Static link order: common → curl → media → tui → core → libsolv** — [01 §5.1](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#51-legacy-build_libzypp) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`SET_LOGGROUP` overwrites `COMPILE_FLAGS`** — [01 §3.3](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#33-the-set_loggroup-macro) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`ENABLE_DEVEL_BUILD` reroutes only helper binaries, not config/plugins/caches** — [01 §6](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#6-enable_devel_build--what-it-reroutes) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`-DSUSE` silently enables docs/translations/tests (doxygen mandatory)** — [01 §3.1](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#31-options) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`make install` layout is incomplete; spec creates the dirs** — [01 §8](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#8-install-layout) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Strings in `.cppm` never reach `zypp.pot`** — [01 §9](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#9-translations-po) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **zypp-stack parent force-sets cache options and `SUSE`** — [01 §11](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#11-the-parent-meta-project-zypp-stack) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Keep `zypp_EARLY_SRCS` order** — [01 §4.2](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#42-target-factory-functions) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **NG needs CMake ≥ 3.28; module units in bottom-up order** — [01 §5.2](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#52-ng-build_libzyppng) · [pitfalls](01-layout-build-and-dependencies.md#pitfalls--special-cases)

## 4. Configuration & environment

* **ZConfig always reads the host `zypp.conf`; only `solver.*`/`multiversion` follow `--root`** — [09 §4](09-configuration-and-environment.md#4-zconfig-and-root-changes) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Any `/etc/zypp/zypp.conf` fully replaces the vendor file (loses multiversion kernel)** — [09 §2.1](09-configuration-and-environment.md#21-the-uapi6--econf-scheme-default) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Drop-ins without `[main]` are ignored (bsc#1272534)** — [09 §2.1](09-configuration-and-environment.md#21-the-uapi6--econf-scheme-default) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`$ZYPP_CONF` is root-relative, disables drop-ins, falls back to builtin defaults** — [09 §2.2](09-configuration-and-environment.md#22-zypp_conf) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`[env]` never overwrites and comes too late for static-init vars** — [09 §2.4](09-configuration-and-environment.md#24-the-env-section-173810) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Many env vars are cached in function statics; later `setenv()` is ignored** — [09 §8](09-configuration-and-environment.md#8-environment-variables-complete-list) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`ZConfig::systemRoot()`/`multiversionSpec()` may create ZYpp and take the lock** — [09 §4](09-configuration-and-environment.md#4-zconfig-and-root-changes) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`ZYPP_TESTSUITE_FAKE_ARCH` makes every commit throw** — [09 §8.1](09-configuration-and-environment.md#81-configuration-and-locking) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Arch detection is cached; CPUID upgrades x86_64; ARM reads host `/etc/rpm/platform`** — [09 §6](09-configuration-and-environment.md#6-architecture-detection) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **Env vars libzypp sets (`BOOST_TEST_CATCH_SYSTEM_ERRORS`, `SYSTEMD_OFFLINE` bsc#1118758, `GLIBC_TUNABLES` bsc#1246912)** — [09 §12](09-configuration-and-environment.md#12-environment-variables-libzypp-sets-and-other-env-side-effects) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`ZYPP_MEDIANETWORK` is set but unused** — [09 §2.5](09-configuration-and-environment.md#25-techpreview-keys) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`update.*dir` ignored, `messagessdir` typo, `credentials.global.*` hardcoded** — [09 §11](09-configuration-and-environment.md#11-zyppconf-key-audit-parser-vs-documentation) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`solver.upgradeTestcasesToKeep=-1` works via unsigned wraparound** — [09 §5](09-configuration-and-environment.md#5-all-zyppconf-keys-read-by-zconfig--mediaconfig) · [pitfalls](09-configuration-and-environment.md#pitfalls--special-cases)

## 5. Logging & exceptions

* **An INT line from `ZYPP_THROW`/`CAUGHT` is not necessarily a bug** — [02 §4](02-core-infrastructure.md#4-exceptions-zypp-logiczypp-corebaseexceptionhcc) · [pitfalls](02-core-infrastructure.md#pitfalls--special-cases)

* **`Capability::c_str()` uses a static 5-slot ring buffer** — [03 §4.4](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#44-capability-capdetail-capabilities) · [pitfalls](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **`Edition::match` is not transitive** — [03 §4.1](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#41-edition--rel--range) · [pitfalls](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **One libsolv pool per process; ids reused, watch `serialIDs()`** — [03 §5.2](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#52-serial-numbers-and-lazy-housekeeping) · [pitfalls](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#pitfalls--special-cases)

* **Foreign-arch solvables are dropped on repo add (except `@System`)** — [03 §5.1](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#51-adding-and-removing-repos-poolimpl) · [pitfalls](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
* **NG signal/EventDispatcher/Task lifetime traps** — [10 §3.2](10-zyppng-next-generation.md#32-base-and-signals-ngbasebaseh-ngbasesignalsh) · [pitfalls](10-zyppng-next-generation.md#pitfalls--special-cases)

## 7. ResStatus & solver semantics

* **Causer order `USER > APPL_HIGH > APPL_LOW > SOLVER`; lock/unlock rules** — [03 §7.3](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#73-resstatus-bit-layout) · [pitfalls](03-sat-pool-and-resolvables.md#pitfalls--special-cases)

## 9. Security

* **There is no persistent zypp keyring** — [06 §2.1](06-security-gpg-keyring.md#21-two-keyrings-both-temporary) · [pitfalls](06-security-gpg-keyring.md#pitfalls--special-cases)
